landing.heroTitle: Launch your Solana token — all in one place
landing.heroSubtitle: Create a token, set up its liquidity pool, and track live market data. No wallet setup, no juggling five tabs. Pay in USDC, withdraw anytime.
landing.featureTokenBody: Name, symbol, supply, logo and metadata — live on Solana in minutes. Mint & freeze authority stay with you.
landing.featurePoolBody: Decide what percentage of supply goes to the pool and what stays for the market. Add or drain liquidity without leaving the site.
landing.featureMarketBody: Every token gets its own profile page with price, chart, liquidity, volume and stats — automatically.
landing.featureWalletBody: A Solana wallet is created for you. Top up USDC, pay for services, and withdraw back to any address.
